rules: Free to download does not mean safe to monetize: show the license summary and ask the user to confirm on the source page.
Music: a Content ID claim can still happen on YouTube even for royalty-free tracks; the YouTube Audio Library is the safest for YouTube.
The MCP never downloads assets; the user downloads into their own library folder and runs asset_library_index.
Record the license per file in the local library; unknown license blocks render_final (rule A1).
Every entry here is unverified until last_verified is set after a manual check.
